<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group to form an alkene (Peterson reaction). This will give us the appropriate template ID to use in the route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"]
}</action_input>
